title: The Lefschetz Type Theorem For Fundamental Group Schemes
summary: Let $k$ be a field, $X$ a connected scheme proper over $k$, $D\subsetneq X$ an ample effective connected divisor, $x\in D(k)$. For Tannakian categories $\mathcal{C}_X$ and $\mathcal{C}_D$ whose objects consist of vector bundles on $X$ and $D$ respectively, we establish general Tannakian criteria for the natural homomorphism \(π(\mathcal{C}_D,x)\to π(\mathcal{C}_X,x)\) to be faithfully flat, a closed immersion, or an isomorphism.
